ConfigureMoves.AddCustomMoveNamesThat: Add custom move names that will appear as selectable actions during downtime. These are freeform labels — no item link required. Use the rest type selector to restrict when each move is available.
ConfigureMoves.DragItemsHereToCreate: Drag items here to create moves linked to specific items. The move will only appear for actors who own the item (matched by name). Use the rest type selector to restrict when each move is available.
ConfigureMoves.IfAnActorOwnsThe: If an actor owns the recipe item (matched by name), the crafted item will be added to their sheet when the downtime move is executed. Items are matched by name.
ConfigureMoves.SwitchOffAnyUserWho: Switch off any user who should never take part in downtime. A disabled user is hidden from the Downtime window even while connected, and is skipped when the downtime effects are applied.
ConfigureMoves.TheseAreTheDefaultCore: These are the default core features used during downtime. You can replace the linked item if needed — the mechanical effect will remain the same, but the system will search for the move by the new item's name.

Core.armorer: When you choose Repair Armor as a downtime move, all allies also clear an Armor Slot.
Core.beastbound: If you choose a downtime move that clears your Stress, your companion clears an equal amount.
Core.changeShape: Shapeshifter. Adds the "Change Shape" downtime move: swap your current ancestry for another and describe how your appearance changes. Spends one move; the swap itself is applied by the player.
Core.efficient: During Short Rest, one selected action can be upgraded to Long Rest quality.
Core.eloquent: Allows granting a bonus move to another party member.
Core.favor: Adds the "Show Tribute" downtime move: describe how you honour your patron and gain Favor equal to your Spellcast trait. Spends one move; the Favor itself is applied by the player.
Core.forager: Grants a bonus Forage action that does not count towards the move limit.
Core.oasis: Duneborne. During a short rest, reroll one die used for a downtime move and keep the higher result. Mark the move with the water badge, or hand the reroll to an ally.
Core.onlySkinDeep: Shapeshifter. Adds the "Only Skin Deep" downtime move: choose a different feature from your current ancestry. Spends one move; the swap itself is applied by the player.
Core.pipeweed: Adds the free "Smoke Pipeweed" move during a short rest. Smoking one clears an additional Stress for every PC who chose Clear Stress, and spends one Pipeweed.
Core.premiumBedroll: During downtime, you automatically clear 1 Stress.
Core.recovery: During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead. You can spend 1 Hope to let an ally do the same.
Core.soothingSpeech: When using Tend to Wounds on another character during Short Rest, clear an additional HP on the target. You also clear 2 HP on yourself.
Core.timekeepersPendant: Grants one additional downtime move each rest.

Labels.battered: Battered; visible wounds or flickering essence betray the toll of battle, slowing them down.
Labels.broken: Broken; they stagger with ragged desperation, their existence hanging by a thread.
Labels.fallen: Fallen; the vessel has succumbed, collapsing into stillness or dissipation.
Labels.guarded: Guarded; a subtle tension tightens their movements, the weight of the moment setting in.
Labels.imposing: Imposing; their form is pristine, radiating an aura of untouched power.
Labels.overwhelmed: Overwhelmed; panic or instability has taken hold, leaving them erratic and unpredictable.
Labels.rattled: Rattled; hesitation fractures their focus, erratic energy revealing their inner turmoil.
Labels.shattered: Shattered; their mental defenses have crumbled, leaving them utterly exposed and vulnerable to any threat.
Labels.unshakeable: Unshakeable; their mind is a fortress, operating with absolute, terrifying clarity.
Labels.weathered: Weathered; minor injuries or disruptions mark their form, but their stance remains firm.
